title: Comunidades restauran bosque seco
text: La nota describe una iniciativa comunitaria para restaurar bosque seco y proteger especies nativas. Incluye cifras de hectareas restauradas y testimonios de lideres locales.

title: Policy debate over nature restoration
text: The article frames biodiversity policy as a conflict between farming costs and long-term ecosystem recovery. It cites government officials, NGOs and farmers.
